+def _collect_anthropic_input_usage(source: dict[str, Any], usage: dict[str, int]) -> None:
+    """Copy the input and cache token counts that `source` reports into `usage`."""
+    if isinstance(input_tokens := source.get("input_tokens"), int):
+        usage[TokenUsageKey.INPUT_TOKENS] = input_tokens
+    if isinstance(cached := source.get("cache_read_input_tokens"), int):
+        usage[TokenUsageKey.CACHE_READ_INPUT_TOKENS] = cached
+    if isinstance(created := source.get("cache_creation_input_tokens"), int):
+        usage[TokenUsageKey.CACHE_CREATION_INPUT_TOKENS] = created
+

+def test_anthropic_extract_streaming_token_usage_message_delta_final_counts():
+    # With server tools, message_delta carries the final cumulative input and cache counts
+    provider = AnthropicProvider(EndpointConfig(**chat_config()))
+    accumulated_usage = {}
+    chunk1 = (
+        b"event: message_start\n"
+        b'data: {"type":"message_start","message":{"id":"msg_123",'
+        b'"usage":{"input_tokens":10,"cache_read_input_tokens":0,'
+        b'"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"output_tokens":1}}}\n'
+    )
+    accumulated_usage.update(provider._extract_streaming_token_usage(chunk1))
+
+    chunk2 = (
+        b"event: message_delta\n"
+        b'data: {"type":"message_delta","delta":{"stop_reason":"end_turn"},'
+        b'"usage":{"input_tokens":120,"cache_read_input_tokens":100,'
+        b'"cache_creation_input_tokens":20,"output_tokens":50}}\n'
+    )
+    accumulated_usage.update(provider._extract_streaming_token_usage(chunk2))
+
+    # Raw counts are merged before normalization adds the cache tokens.
+    assert accumulated_usage == {
+        "input_tokens": 120,
+        "output_tokens": 50,
+        "cache_read_input_tokens": 100,
+        "cache_creation_input_tokens": 20,
+    }
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_chat_stream_usage_takes_final_counts_from_message_delta():
+    resp = chat_stream_response()
+    delta_index = next(
+        i for i, line in enumerate(resp) if line.startswith(b'data: {"type": "message_delta"')
+    )
+    resp[delta_index] = (
+        b'data: {"type": "message_delta", "delta": {"stop_reason": "end_turn", '
+        b'"stop_sequence":null}, "usage":{"input_tokens": 120, "cache_read_input_tokens": 100, '
+        b'"cache_creation_input_tokens": 20, "output_tokens": 15}}\n'
+    )
+
+    with mock.patch(
+        "aiohttp.ClientSession.post", return_value=MockAsyncStreamingResponse(resp)
+    ) as mock_post:
+        provider = AnthropicProvider(EndpointConfig(**chat_config()))
+        response = provider.chat_stream(chat.RequestPayload(**chat_payload(stream=True)))
+        chunks = [jsonable_encoder(chunk) async for chunk in response]
+
+    mock_post.assert_called_once()
+    usage = chunks[-1]["usage"]
+    # input_tokens (120) excludes the cache tokens: 120 + 100 + 20
+    assert usage["prompt_tokens"] == 240
+    assert usage["completion_tokens"] == 15
+    assert usage["total_tokens"] == 255
+    assert usage["prompt_tokens_details"]["cached_tokens"] == 100
+

+import json
+from unittest import mock
+
+import pytest
+
+from mlflow.gateway.config import EndpointConfig
+from mlflow.gateway.providers.anthropic import AnthropicProvider
+from mlflow.gateway.providers.bedrock import AmazonBedrockProvider
+from mlflow.gateway.providers.vertex_ai import VertexAIProvider
+from mlflow.gateway.schemas import chat
+
+INVALID_INPUT_USAGE = {
+    "input_tokens": "120",
+    "cache_read_input_tokens": 100.5,
+    "cache_creation_input_tokens": [],
+}
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(params=["anthropic", "amazon-bedrock", "vertex_ai"])
+def provider(request):
+    match request.param:
+        case "anthropic":
+            provider_class = AnthropicProvider
+            config = {"anthropic_api_key": "test-key"}
+        case "amazon-bedrock":
+            provider_class = AmazonBedrockProvider
+            config = {"aws_config": {"aws_region": "us-east-1"}}
+        case "vertex_ai":
+            provider_class = VertexAIProvider
+            config = {"vertex_project": "test-project", "vertex_location": "us-east5"}
+    provider = provider_class(
+        EndpointConfig(
+            name="test-endpoint",
+            endpoint_type="llm/v1/chat",
+            model={"provider": request.param, "name": "claude-sonnet-4-5", "config": config},
+        )
+    )
+    return provider._delegate if request.param == "vertex_ai" else provider
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("combine_chunks", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("delta_usage", "expected_input", "expected_read", "expected_creation"),
+    [
+        ([{}], 140, 25, 15),
+        ([{"input_tokens": 120}], 160, 25, 15),
+        ([{"cache_read_input_tokens": 40}], 155, 40, 15),
+        ([{"cache_creation_input_tokens": 30}], 155, 25, 30),
+        ([{"cache_read_input_tokens": 40}, {"input_tokens": 120}], 175, 40, 15),
+        ([INVALID_INPUT_USAGE], 140, 25, 15),
+        (
+            [{"input_tokens": None, "cache_read_input_tokens": None}],
+            140,
+            25,
+            15,
+        ),
+        (
+            [{"input_tokens": 0, "cache_read_input_tokens": 0, "cache_creation_input_tokens": 0}],
+            0,
+            0,
+            0,
+        ),
+        (
+            [
+                {
+                    "input_tokens": 120,
+                    "cache_read_input_tokens": 100,
+                    "cache_creation_input_tokens": 20,
+                }
+            ],
+            240,
+            100,
+            20,
+        ),
+    ],
+)
+async def test_stream_passthrough_accumulates_raw_usage(
+    provider, combine_chunks, delta_usage, expected_input, expected_read, expected_creation
+):
+    events = [
+        {
+            "type": "message_start",
+            "message": {
+                "usage": {
+                    "input_tokens": 100,
+                    "cache_read_input_tokens": 25,
+                    "cache_creation_input_tokens": 15,
+                }
+            },
+        },
+        *[
+            {"type": "message_delta", "usage": {"output_tokens": 50, **usage}}
+            for usage in delta_usage
+        ],
+    ]
+    chunks = [f"data: {json.dumps(event)}\n\n".encode() for event in events]
+    if combine_chunks:
+        chunks = [b"".join(chunks)]
+
+    async def stream():
+        for chunk in chunks:
+            yield chunk
+
+    with mock.patch.object(provider, "_set_span_token_usage") as set_usage:
+        assert [
+            chunk async for chunk in provider._stream_passthrough_with_usage(stream())
+        ] == chunks
+
+    set_usage.assert_called_once_with({
+        "input_tokens": expected_input,
+        "output_tokens": 50,
+        "total_tokens": expected_input + 50,
+        "cache_read_input_tokens": expected_read,
+        "cache_creation_input_tokens": expected_creation,
+    })
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("provider", ["anthropic"], indirect=True)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("start_usage", "delta_usage", "expected_prompt"),
+    [
+        (
+            {"input_tokens": 100, "cache_read_input_tokens": 25, "cache_creation_input_tokens": 15},
+            INVALID_INPUT_USAGE,
+            140,
+        ),
+        (
+            INVALID_INPUT_USAGE,
+            {"input_tokens": 120},
+            120,
+        ),
+    ],
+)
+async def test_chat_stream_ignores_invalid_input_usage(
+    provider, start_usage, delta_usage, expected_prompt
+):
+    events = [
+        {
+            "type": "message_start",
+            "message": {
+                "id": "msg_test",
+                "model": provider.config.model.name,
+                "usage": start_usage,
+            },
+        },
+        {
+            "type": "message_delta",
+            "delta": {"stop_reason": "end_turn"},
+            "usage": {"output_tokens": 50, **delta_usage},
+        },
+    ]
+
+    async def stream():
+        for event in events:
+            yield f"data: {json.dumps(event)}\n\n".encode()
+
+    with mock.patch(
+        "mlflow.gateway.providers.anthropic.send_stream_request", return_value=stream()
+    ) as send_request:
+        chunks = [
+            chunk
+            async for chunk in provider._chat_stream(
+                chat.RequestPayload(messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}], stream=True)
+            )
+        ]
+
+    send_request.assert_called_once()
+    assert chunks[-1].usage.prompt_tokens == expected_prompt
+    assert chunks[-1].usage.completion_tokens == 50
+    assert chunks[-1].usage.total_tokens == expected_prompt + 50
